title: Descending a whole generic-fibre isomorphism to a base open
statement: Let X,Y,S be affine schemes [def-weil-affine-spectrum], S integral [def-pc-integral-scheme], and f:X -> S and g:Y -> S locally finitely presented [def-sbc-locally-finite-presentation]. Let eta be a generic point and e:X_eta -> Y_eta an isomorphism of fibres [def-pc-scheme-fibre] over Spec kappa(eta). There exists an open U of S containing eta and an isomorphism f^{-1}(U) -> g^{-1}(U) commuting with their structure maps to S. The fibres may be empty.

source.place: Tag 01ZM, lemma-descend-finite-presentation, parts (2) and (3); Tag 0GWT, local-ring spectrum limit.

proof.text: Use the affine-open basis to make affine neighbourhoods of eta a nonempty cofiltered diagram. The existing Scheme.fromSpecStalk_limit_affine_neighbourhoods gives the limit cone with point Spec of the stalk. The stalk at a generic point of an integral scheme is a field (Mathlib isField_stalk_of_closure_mem_irreducibleComponents); its residue map is therefore an isomorphism. Transport the cone along Spec of this isomorphism to obtain the canonical cone with point Spec kappa(eta). The private nhdsCone_limit proof implements this transport and uniqueness explicitly.

Use the top neighbourhood as base stage, identified with S by topIso. The fibre squares, with the second transported along e and its compatibility over kappa(eta), exhibit a common limit model for X and Y. The stage models are affine, hence qcqs, and locally finitely presented.

Apply the existing source-library exists_iso_of_isPullback, the isomorphism wrapper of Tag 01ZM: descend the two inverse morphisms using part (2), and their inverse identities using eventual equality in part (3). Obtain an isomorphism of their two base changes at an affine neighbourhood U of eta.

The canonical pullback comparisons identify the two base changes with f^{-1}(U) and g^{-1}(U). Conjugate the descended isomorphism by these comparisons. Their projection equations give compatibility over U; composing with its inclusion proves compatibility over S.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_base_open_iso_of_generic_fibre_iso
    {X Y S : Scheme.{u}} [IsAffine X] [IsAffine Y] [IsAffine S] [IsIntegral S]
    (f : X ⟶ S) (g : Y ⟶ S)
    [LocallyOfFinitePresentation f] [LocallyOfFinitePresentation g]
    (η : S) (hη : IsGenericPoint η Set.univ)
    (e : f.fiber η ≅ g.fiber η)
    (he : e.hom ≫ g.fiberToSpecResidueField η = f.fiberToSpecResidueField η) :
    ∃ U : S.Opens, η ∈ U ∧
      ∃ eU : (f ⁻¹ᵁ U).toScheme ≅ (g ⁻¹ᵁ U).toScheme,
        eU.hom ≫ (g ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι ≫ g = (f ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι ≫ f
